customer: caller says she wants to sell her convertible but its titled to her and her mom and her mom cant make it to the apointment, wants to know if she can just sign it herself
agent: Customer, a college student in North Carolina, asked whether she could sell her co-owned convertible alone since her mother can't attend the appraisal. Explained per 'When more than one person owns the car' that if names on the title are joined by 'and' every owner must sign, but if joined by 'or' only one owner needs to sign. Advised that the easiest option is for all owners to attend with photo IDs, and that an owner who can't come can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-1, which must be notarized. Customer will check how the names appear on the title.
